en: Color postcard showing a busy central square with landscaped flowerbeds, pedestrians and blue-white buses. Dominating the left side is an ornate Art Nouveau building with a multicolored tiled roof (the Culture Palace). Curving boulevard lined with mid‑century blocks and older façades; a small domed tower appears in the distance. Reverse side has Romanian layout and pricing.
